_comment: Demo regions (decision D6, 2026-11-15). The ingest reads the bbox [west, south, east, north] from the mirror; the geometry is the official boundary (IGN via geoBoundaries, CC BY 4.0) used to clip detections when the calendar is built.

regions.name: Spain (mainland and Balearic Islands)
regions.why: Main demo region. On the Aqua MODIS scale it has about 1,000 to 4,000 vegetation detections a year, enough for a full month-by-year calendar, and the per-month VIIRS/Aqua day ratio varies (about 3.4 to 5.6), so the seasonal calibration is visible. The Canary Islands are left out: a different fire regime 1,000 km away, and the 2021 La Palma eruption adds about 31,000 detections that FIRMS types as vegetation.

regions.name: Aragón
regions.why: Local story for the Zaragoza event. Only about 40 to 60 vegetation detections a year on the Aqua MODIS scale, too few for its own per-month factors, so its calibration should borrow strength from Spain instead of standing alone.
